newsitem.title: POLAND: Shell's Wavin ups stake in Polish plant.
newsitem.headline: Shell's Wavin ups stake in Polish plant.

text.p: Plastics maker Wavin BV, 50- percent owned unit of Royal Dutch/Shell, has raised to 67 percent its stake in its Polish subsidiary Wavin-Metalplast, PAP news agency said on Monday.
It said Wavin's equity in Wavin-Metalplast, a plastic installation materials maker based western Poland, has been increased through a purchase of a 26-percent stake from the treasury.
"We want to invest in new products and expand the existing production on the Polish market," PAP quoted Wavin president Fons Driessen as saying.
Wavin-Metalplast employs 450 workers and specialises in plastic pipes production.
PAP report gave no further details.
